assumptions.origin: After deterministic main-story pass, at Boris; main-story traversal time excluded; actual 920 coins and school XP retained; no side-quest/daily/coven/duel/payment income
assumptions.dailyPlay: 30/60/120 active minutes per 24 h from model origin; a combat can finish past session boundary; movement/wait/craft/trade may span offline break; no offline income or school XP
assumptions.research: Real single queue, live timers; costs/XP consumed; finish/start checked at closed cycle boundaries (conservative polling delay)
assumptions.strategy: One target school to V; reserve only next unstarted research materials. Gather all/nearest for coins when below max(1000,next coin price+300). Otherwise alternate frostwood/graveyard first; bosses first, collect their cache immediately; add forest combats for missing embers. Ten-minute expedition windows plus actual service/return time.
assumptions.supplies: Life medium x2, mana medium x1, warm x1, crystal shield x1; four fixed slots, actual purchases and one-item crafts; final HP/MP and supplies restored after each expedition
assumptions.equipment: Actual main-story forest amulet +0, no free additional equipment; bags expand for 300 sapphires when nearly full or brewing needs temporary space; gather-only recovery if the expansion is not yet affordable; retained rare resources are not assumed sellable
assumptions.random: Fixed combat bot seed; independent seeded actual loot sequences. Two progression seeds and four finalist seeds are examples, not confidence intervals.
assumptions.limits: Not globally optimal routing or levelling; aggro/contact and human reaction delays excluded; not a new-player story duration estimate; amulet +5/all schools together not simulated; no economy config changes

assumptions.tracker: already owned and equipped; acquisition cost excluded
assumptions.scope: poststory open gates; no fighting, aggro/contact or human delay model; only this finite policy family
